subject: Private deploy: intermittent return-path failures after maintenance (policy drift)
messages:
From: Tom Liu <tom@greenfield.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit@greenfield.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 08:14:22 -0700
Subject: [Greenfield] Intermittent failures to private deployment after maintenance

Vanessa —

We saw an uptick in 504s and connection resets to our on-prem API behind the private deployment beginning right after your maintenance window this morning (06:00-07:00 PT). Application notes: short-lived POST requests succeed occasionally but many requests fail with TCP RST and we observe long tail retries.

Customer-side quick checks:
- Pings to the private frontdoor succeed from our app fleet (~5ms)
- curl from app to service sometimes hangs; when it fails we see RSTs from the Redwood egress IP
- tcpdump on our side attached: summary shows SYN/ACK then immediate RST for a subset of sessions (attached as session-pcap.tgz)

We think something changed in firewall/security policy or NAT behavior during the maintenance. Can the team help triage ASAP? This is impacting a subset of our customers routed through a specific SNAT pool.

-Amit (on behalf of Greenfield)

Attachment: session-pcap.tgz (pcap, ~1.1MB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom@greenfield.ai>, Amit Rao <amit@greenfield.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:02:11 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Greenfield] Intermittent failures to private deployment after maintenance

Thanks for the heads up, Tom/Amit — sorry for the impact. I pulled the attached pcap and see a consistent pattern where the 3-way handshake completes but the server side sends a RST shortly after (within 50–200ms) for ~20% of sessions.

Initial ask for the internal triage team:
1) Marissa — can you check the private VPC security group change logs and NAT pool activity during the maintenance window?
2) Karthik/Neha — can you validate whether any automated policy reconciler ran (we had a brief rollout to normalize SGs across private clusters) and whether return-path routing changed for the affected ACCT SNAT range?
3) Everyone — please call out any short-term workaround we can ask the customer to apply while we debug.

Cc'ing Greenfield so they're aware of owners. I may request a temporary SG exception if we confirm a drift.

- Vanessa

Signature:
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Tom Liu <tom@greenfield.ai>, Amit Rao <amit@greenfield.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:15:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Greenfield] Intermittent failures to private deployment after maintenance

Quick triage notes (I checked the cloud control plane + audit logs):
- At 06:22 PT an automated policy reconciler pushed SG profile "private-common-2026-06" to the Greenfield private VPC (job id: reconcile-4389).
- The reconciler added a new egress rule with a deny-by-default catch-all that was intended to be restrictive for a set of unused clusters; due to a tag mismatch it applied to the Greenfield workload group.
- Audit config line: (audit-sg-change.log attached) shows rule insertion: "deny tcp 1024-65535 from 10.45.0.0/22 to 198.51.100.0/24" — this blocks ephemeral return ports from the customer side when the SNAT mapping uses a client-source ephemeral mapping pattern.

Conntrack evidence from a dataplane snapshot (conntrack-snapshot.txt attached):
- High rate of conntrack DELETE for tuples originating from the customer's SNAT pool IPs after ephemeral port assignment; suggests server-side sees connections as invalid (return path mismatch) and RSTs/ICMP errors follow.

Short-term mitigation I recommend:
1) Roll back the single reconciler change to the previous SG snapshot for Greenfield (rollback id: reconcile-4388) — this is the quickest path.
2) If rollback is not allowed immediately, create a temporary SG exception allowing TCP 1024-65535 from 10.45.0.0/22 to the Redwood egress pool for the affected cluster.

I'll stand by to apply rollback or create the exception.

- Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Tom Liu <tom@greenfield.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:03:58 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Greenfield] Intermittent failures to private deployment after maintenance

Thanks Marissa — rough confirmation from the routing side: during the reconciler run we updated a path preference which caused symmetric return traffic to take a different egress hop from a downstream NAT cluster. That cluster uses a different SNAT translation pool and, crucially, we do not currently preserve source port mapping across those egress hops. The result: client -> service uses SNAT-A (ports preserved), but return flows hit SNAT-B which reassigns ephemeral ports and breaks the 5-tuple.

Mitigation options (ordered by speed):
- Temporary: add the SG exception Marissa suggested + pin the Greenfield ASN to the original egress cluster via a local route (short-lived) so return path remains symmetric.
- Shorter-term: enable SNAT session affinity for the affected SNAT pool so translations are sticky for 30s–5m depending on workload.
- Long-term: update reconciler to do tag-scoped SG changes only and add a preflight check that validates SNAT pool affinity won't be affected (we should fail the reconciler job if cross-pool egress routing would change).

I can apply the route pin and toggle SNAT affinity if we get signoff.

- Karthik

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom@greenfield.ai>, Amit Rao <amit@greenfield.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 12:25:47 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Greenfield] Intermittent failures to private deployment after maintenance

Plan of action (immediate):
- Marissa: execute rollback of reconcile-4389 to reconcile-4388 now (exempting the Greenfield VPC). Please confirm when done.
- Karthik: apply a temporary route pin for Greenfield SNAT ASN to the original egress cluster and enable SNAT affinity for the affected pool for 2 hours.
- Neha: prepare a follow-up change for the reconciler preflight checks and schedule a review with infra tomorrow.
- Vanessa: I'll coordinate with Greenfield and provide a single message once we confirm the rollback + route pin.

Attachments I am pushing to the ticket: session-pcap.tgz, audit-sg-change.log, conntrack-snapshot.txt

Target: rollback + route pin complete by 13:10 PT (45m). If we miss the target we'll escalate the SLA credits process with Sales.

- Vanessa

From: Tom Liu <tom@greenfield.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit@greenfield.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:42:09 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Greenfield] Intermittent failures to private deployment after maintenance

Vanessa / team — thanks, we see a marked reduction in errors after 13:05 PT. Rollback + route pin look to have restored symmetric return paths. We'll continue to monitor for another 2 hours but traffic looks stable and error rate is down to baseline.

Request: please follow up with a short postmortem that includes: what caused the reconciler to apply to the wrong tag, what safeguards will be added to prevent recurrence, and the timeline for a permanent fix.

Appreciate the quick response.

- Tom
